Class OrganigramUnitsTag

java.lang.Object
javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.TagSupport
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.view.users.OrganigramUnitsTag
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.IterationTag, javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.JspTag, javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.Tag
public class OrganigramUnitsTag extends javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.TagSupport

Prints the given levels of the organigram, starting from a given point. Used for the invalid input: '<'search:organigram /> tags.

While this may work, it is quite crappy design indeed. It should be refactored as:

  • An Organigram TAG
  • Several strategies to create a Layout out of a data structure.
  • Several classes which Transform a Layout into a viewable representation (HTML, GIF, PDF, etc)

Version:
1.0
Author:
Daniel Varela
